column3: dwellers in the world of gods
ornament of the world of gods
in the valley of the mountain where the best of divine women play
with raised weapons to destroy the foes of the gods
with raised weapons to destroy the foes of the gods, endowed with eight arm-staffs
worthy of the best of gods
of the chiefs of gods, Siddhas and sages
of fresh sougandhika garlands fallen from gods' women's hair
the gods, the Self in the Self
the army of gods grows thence
leaders of the enemies of gods (demons)
enemies of gods, I, of those who approached
marks of temples of gods, gardens, wells, livelihood
gods, demons, Charanas, hosts of Siddhas
sung by lords of gods and demons
sung by lords of gods and demons, of great power
trembled by arm-strength of lords of gods and demons
his feet saluted by lords of gods and demons
gods, demons, serpents, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Vidyadharas
crushed by the enemy army (of gods' enemies)
by lords of gods Brahma, Rudra and nine
hosts of lords of gods too
gods and men came slowly to Videha
easily attained by austerities, by yoga
of the very lovely divine women
desiring gold, afflicted with desire for fire
by those well ripened in yoga
we shall see by very beautiful
they say the praise of qualities of the crown jewel of fame
nectar of deeds of the crown jewel of fame
by deep sleep, dream, waking, functions of maya, is known
greatly agitated, the two struck each other
in very prosperous houses, gardens, pleasure-groves
sight of friends and so on
of the two friends of the world's Self
grieved, thwarted wish to see friends
friend, knower of the truth of counsel
boars and others, this too for attaining the Self's path
by well-spoken speech, exceedingly rising crowd of qualities, incarnations and victories
by good speech uttered by brahmanas
I of the subtle ones also
the Lord would place the subtle
the suta, with folded hands bowed
killed deer and lions with floods of missiles
not permitted even at the slaughter
the wise, O Lord of three, of the whole world's stain
the wise, having plunged in the nectar-ocean of stories destroying all stains of the world
by the wise in the assembly of gods
by the wise, from desire to know truth directly
with aerial cars like sun, fire, moon
sun, moon, fire, wind, ocean, waters
where sun, moon, wind, fire do not go
about to give birth then split
by the corners of the mouth
by howls of jackals and owls
I am created, impelled by sight alone
went to the bridge destroying great sins
by army and others, the best of his attendants
serving, hearing, reading, seeing destroys sin
of those whose minds love service, even Shiva
Lord of the lords, with lords
with Om, from desire to tell of four priests' functions
both cutting off brothers' lives, this of me
he, of false vows, ill-conduct, wicked
he, subtle being placed inside the body
he, in the lake with great strength
he ran after, in bear form
he too is part, quality, time, Self
he, taking water in cupped hands
he too dwelt in the forest
he, having attained great yoga glory
drank Soma by moon and sun
Soma, Self, Isha, born of Brahma
he, lord of nectar and fearlessness
Soma became from a part of Brahma
he lay in the ocean water
he, having eaten, honoured, brought hospitality
he indeed is the divine one
removed the fragrance of sougandhika flowers
with talk capable of brotherly questioning
like a butcher taking the jewel
king of Saubha said this loudly
Saubhari, Utanka, Shibi, Devala, Pippalada, Sarasvata, Uddhava, Parashara, Bhurishena
grieved for the sons of Surabhi
satisfied with qualities of good nature
rice grain... cooked by that heat (fragment)
all senses carried off by remembering the Endless (fragment)
this too for attaining the Self's path (fragment)
took up a terrible sharp sword consecrated by him (fragment)
enough of dark friends, hard to abandon, whose tale is the goal (fragment)
disregarding that, only the position of the unreal (fragment)
craving for unmanifest goal of brahmins, relying on that (fragment)
by sight of him, thrill of festival and trembling (fragment)
the two Ashvins on the breasts (fragment)
